name: hawkins-commodity-resolve-guard

repair.key: order_refusal:kalshi-shadow:this market is expected to resolve in # hours; entries must resolve within #

why: New corrected child of hawkins-3, retaining Kalshi/day WTI and diesel favourites. The parent checks trading-close time but not payout time. Require finite hours_to_resolve in [0, 48] for entries and cancel resting buys that fail that same check, without substituting hours_to_close. All other strategy logic and parameters are preserved. Starts at rung 0 with no inherited qualification or performance record.
